name: aoop_service_availability_degradation_max_runtime_seconds
description: Soft execution time budget; one individual calculation may exceed it.

name: aoop_service_availability_degradation_batch_size
description: Maximum successful/failed calculations per scheduled execution.

name: aoop_service_availability_degradation_cursor
description: Internal cursor over degradation outages; no custom queue table.

name: aoop_service_availability_calculate_degradation
description: Enable AOOP supplemental degradation calculation and invalidation.

name: aoop_service_availability_degradation_usecommitment
description: Use commitment schedule, timezone and maintenance windows. Reprocess affected scope after changing.

name: aoop_service_availability_degradation_color_ranges
description: Faixas dos indicadores de degradação no formulário e lista. JSON: quatro objetos max/color, limites crescentes entre 0 e 100, último limite=100. Cores green/yellow/orange/red. Cada faixa começa acima do limite anterior. Leitura direta sem BR de sincronização. Recarregue a página após editar. Configuração inválida usa as faixas padrão 25/50/75/100. Não altera os cálculos.
